messages:
mira: Heads-up: external pentest vendor is asking for a retest window after our remediation sprint. Need to coordinate RBAC temporary roles, KMS read-only access, and an evidence handoff plan. Can we lock a 2-hour slot Wed next week?
jon: Wed works for infra. What time zone? also need to know which services are in-scope so we can pre-create ephemeral roles.
mira: PT vendor is UTC. Proposed 13:00-15:00 UTC. In-scope: api-gateway, inference-serving, and console-auth. Exclusions: analytics pipeline.
nana: (SRE) we can carve an ops role with just AssumeRole for that window. Suggest TTL 2h + 15m buffer. Do we need read access to KMS for them?
sam: Product wants results ASAP. We should require only metadata-level KMS access (decrypt audit keys?) — vendor only needs to verify KMS-wrapped artifacts, not rewrap live keys.
jon: Agreed. We'll provide a KMS proxy endpoint that returns key metadata and wrapped-key checksums. No direct Decrypt. We can whitelist vendor IPs and enforce mTLS.
mira: Good. Also need an evidence manifest with checksums for uploaded artifacts. Prefer presigned S3 links with 1h TTL. Vendor will accept sha256 checksums alongside each file.
nana: I'll script the upload helper. Quick snippet for the manifest format:
```
{
  "artifact": "service-a-stack-trace.tgz",
  "sha256": "<hex>",
  "s3_url": "https://...",
  "signed_by": "mira",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-25T12:34:00Z"
}
```
jon: For audit logging, make sure we flip on the pen_test=true sampling flag so we capture full request/response traces for those upload events. We'll route those to the read-only evidence bucket telemetry view.
mira: Can sec-bot run through the checklist? I want confirmation on RBAC policy and audit retention.
sec-bot: checklist: 1) Ephemeral role created (TTL 02:15) - pending 2) KMS proxy endpoint - in progress 3) Presigned links TTL 01:00 - pending 4) Audit sampling tag pen_test=true - pending 5) Evidence manifest template - created
sam: For remediation tracking, let's spin up a temporary Jira board (PT-RETEST-2026-03-31). We'll track vuln ids with columns triage -> fix-in-progress -> verified -> closed. Can we require a verification job that replays the vendor's repro steps?
mira: Yes, verification job must be automated where possible. For manual repros, vendor will include step-by-step runbook. Add a field in the ticket: "verify_command" and attach the manifest link.
nana: Ops notes: We'll throttle tests on inference-serving to preserve prod SLOs. Add a canary subnet and ensure rate limit 50 rps max. If latencies degrade > 20% we abort.
jon: Also add an automatic fallback policy: if dedicated capacity is exhausted, route vendor checks to a compatible model variant in staging with identical API surface. Documented in the runbook.
mira: Timing sync: I'll post an official invite once infra confirms role creation and presigned links script. Aim to have everything ready 24h before window.
sam: One more: legal asked for a short NDA addendum for the retest access window — I can attach to the ticket, vendor already signed one but addendum mentions ephemeral roles.
sec-bot: audit retention note: events tagged pen_test=true will be retained for 180 days in the evidence-readonly stream. Alerts will be suppressed for that tag unless severity >= high.
mira: Thanks all — next steps: ana to create role + presigned helper, jon to finish KMS proxy, sam to make Jira board & attach NDA, I'll prepare manifest and runbook. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
